headline: Restored SubQ injection sites and clearer nasal preparation tracking

changes.title: Restored four SubQ administration-site choices
changes.detail: Left flank, Right flank, Left glute and Right glute are available again in Log Dose; prior saved site names and histories are preserved.

changes.title: Connected nasal vial setup to the shared preparation Review
changes.detail: Existing unlabelled open vials now enter the same nasal preparation form as Open New Vial, with historical preparation date, recorded liquids, known prior-spray reconciliation or an unverified-balance warning. LIVE transfer and spray saving remain disabled.

changes.title: Preserved source and balance protections
changes.detail: Exact source-to-container reconciliation is tested using fictional data. Unknown prior use blocks inventory-backed spray logging and never fabricates historical doses.

dataImpact: No destructive migration, automatic historical edits, or inventory rewrite. Existing production localStorage, backups, protocols, Check-Ins, dose history and original vial/source identifiers remain unchanged. The four restored SubQ values use the existing saved-site spelling. Both LIVE nasal preparation and administration safety gates remain OFF.
limitations: Nasal preparation and inventory-backed spray logging remain unavailable in LIVE; the retrospective workflow is validated in isolated fictional DEMO only.

User-reported physical iPhone nasal workflow acceptance passed 4/4 on prior source fd68a110; the subsequent four-site SubQ restoration passed automated browser regressions but has not received separate physical iPhone/VoiceOver acceptance.
Dose and spray arithmetic is nominal; the app cannot independently verify pump calibration, delivery, sterility or suitability. No safety claim follows from calculator test success.
Primary Cloudflare deployment must be independently verified against the final release metadata commit before publication status is marked published.
